name: @veren/app-host-verify
description: Use only in an isolated DSH test profile to verify the app-host assembly against the real host: this probe plugin runs the six phase-2 checks (services resolve, agent/created payload shape, agent-scoped tool visibility across two real sessions, reopen-reuses-session, task notice lands in a real session log) and writes a JSON verdict; never install it in a product profile.
